summary: Agent workflow graph that plays a run from lead agent to planner, three parallel agents and a reviewer, with light along live edges.

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Presence attribute. Starts a run 800 ms after the element connects.

events.name: done
events.description: Fires when the reviewer finishes a run.

methods.description: Plays one simulated run of about five seconds and resolves when it ends. Calls during a run return at once and do nothing.

accessibility: The status next to the heading is an `aria-live="polite"` region with messages such as `Orchestrating`, `3 agents in parallel` and `Done in 5.1s`.
Node labels are text. Their running and done states are shown by colour and a `data-s` attribute, and read out through visually hidden text after the label (`, running`, `, done`).
The Run button has `aria-disabled="true"` during a run and ignores presses; it stays focusable, so keyboard focus is kept.
Edges, packets and halos are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion, each step waits 60 ms so a run finishes almost at once, and no packets travel along live edges.
notes: The graph, labels and timings are built-in demo data; step durations include some randomness.
Below 520px of host width the layout switches to vertical and the stage grows from 196px to 262px tall.

data.note: The agent graph, its labels and the run timings (partly random) are invented; only `label` and `autoplay` can be set.
